# Tabler outline icons

Eight unmodified SVGs from `@tabler/icons` **3.50.0**, MIT licensed.

- Upstream: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/tree/v3.50.0
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tabler/icons/-/icons-3.50.0.tgz
- Package SHA-512 integrity: `sha512-HflLxyrH1cqC7s7jzQGSjpsTAVIoaf7+/yHjbdM59rJQBMjliibp+LYhDPFxOMcwa1M8DNpOk6ENzQiWn9a1Dg==`
- Original files: `package/icons/outline/{name}.svg`; license: `package/LICENSE`.

The standard-library build embeds only explicitly selected icons into HTML,
adds decorative accessibility attributes, and ships the original license.
No package manager, icon font, CDN or icon runtime is needed.
